amendments: 3600-second interval omitted; original five-interval scope would require a separately frozen 14400-second trace.
One independent successful witness per predefined mechanism episode; repeated polling does not multiply the denominator.
B3 uses the sampled B2 information budget, with ordering/expiry ignored for its union candidate set.
T uses full-resolution configuration and exact observed issuance lineage. T-S shares B2 inputs and semantics; equality is expected and reported.
S4 rolls back chain capability at 3000 and chain issuance at 3300 to verify both transitions separately.
Ten-per-core, five-control cohort is a proposal. Scaling is blocked until live pilots and resource review pass.

Primary matching now checks each direct witness at its request time for time-aware methods. B0/B3 are explicitly atemporal retrospective hypotheses. Historical structure recovery remains separate; prior appearance of a structure does not count as B1 detection of a later persistence instance.
S5 negative adjudication is limited to the observed-credential, declared-writer experiment model; it does not certify all hypothetical AWS issuance paths.

S1 reference eligibility starts at 1800 seconds, after every phase has its first nominal sample; early baseline probes are retained but do not create a left-boundary sampling artifact in the stable control.
